item.text:
### (a) Three posts

1. We know what is at stake: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will be used to cause a disaster that kills thousands of people. We must act now to prevent that future.

2. We refuse to accept thousands of deaths as the price of technological progress. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will be used to cause a deadly disaster. We demand prevention, not promises.

3. We draw a clear line: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will be used to cause a disaster that kills thousands. We must stop treating its development as inevitable and start making public safety nonnegotiable.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will be used to cause a disaster that kills thousands of people. We will not accept that future as the unavoidable cost of progress. We must confront the decisions being made today: who gets to build these systems, what limits apply, and whose lives are put at risk. We demand enforceable safeguards and public accountability before development moves forward. We cannot wait for catastrophe to prove that prevention mattered. Together, we must insist that human lives come before competitive advantage, corporate ambition, and the race to build machines more powerful than ourselves.
